# BAFO build status

Final snapshot: **2026-09-30, after the final hardening round.** That round covered the security review, the live end-to-end tests, the content and glossary pass, and the final QA.

- **Section 0** is the summary: the status of every area, the precise remaining items and the test totals.
- **Sections 1–3** keep the detailed record of what each area built.
- **Section 4** is how to run the stack; the root `README.md` covers the same ground for newcomers.
- **Section 5** is the scaffold alignment log of 2026-09-29.

**Status values**

- **done**: the area's MVP contract scope is implemented, wired into the app and covered by tests. Any remaining items are small defects, optional improvements, or items that wait on an external dependency such as keys, a Firebase project or a design asset.
- **partial**: part of the area's scope is not built, or not verified, in this repository.

The contract is in `BRIEF.md`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `API.md`, `CONVENTIONS.md` and `SCREENS.md`. The MVP scope is in `docs/02_design/mvp_reconciled.md` §6.1, and the scope deferred after launch is in §8 of the same file.

### 0.4 Needs the user (environment)

- **Restart the shared stack** (`scripts/dev.sh`) when convenient. The queue worker keeps the code it loaded at start, so the listener changes of this round are not live in jobs it runs yet: the e2e fixes and the `CompetitionNotifier` guard of §0.5. The HTTP server picks up changes by itself.
- **Dev database `bafo`.** It is seeded: 9 users, 15 competitions, 1 admin and 4 plans on 2026-09-30. It still has the older platform rows: empty `store_links` and `support`, and English-first Arabic legal documents.
  - Placeholders: `php artisan db:seed --class='App\Modules\Platform\Database\Seeders\PlatformDemoSeeder'`.
  - Legal documents: they change on a fresh seed (`scripts/reset-db.sh --yes`), or by editing them in the admin.
- **iOS.** Run the commands in the iOS row above.
- **Leftovers.** Invoice and report PDFs from the dev and e2e stacks are in `apps/api/storage/app/private`. Errors from before this round are in `apps/api/storage/logs/laravel.log`: the `CompetitionNotifier::updated(): … null given` entries, now fixed. Neither was deleted, because they cannot be told apart from other stacks' files.
- **`apps/api/CLAUDE.md`** tells agents to run `composer require laravel/boost` and `boost:install`. No agent did it: it is outside the contract and would change the shared `composer.json` and `composer.lock`. Review or remove that instruction.

### 0.5 Changes made in the final QA round

- **Fix: queued attachment notification.** `CompetitionNotifier::attachmentAdded()` failed with a `TypeError` when the draft was deleted (soft delete) before the queued `NotifyAttachmentAdded` listener ran. This is the "upload a document, then delete the draft" flow, and it is the source of the `null given` errors in the shared log. It now returns without sending. It is backward compatible. Regression test: `tests/Feature/Notifications/CompetitionEventsTest.php` («skips an attachment whose draft was deleted before the queued listener ran»).
- **Docs:** root `README.md` (overview in English and Arabic, architecture, setup, tests, APK, iOS, environment, fake vs real, deferred scope), root `.gitignore` (all three apps' build outputs, keys and `.env` files), and this section.

API.md §3.5: public `offers`, `results`, `awards` (keyset cursor that keeps µs), `awards/{id}`, and `erp-sync` (idempotent, refs stored on the award). **BAFO** start and finish (T7/T8), the `EndBafoRound` job and `bidding:tick`. **Award, revoke and re-award** (T10/T11), with justification and reserve guards and `award.issued` in the audit feed. **Admin `VoidOffer`** (rebuild and re-rank; the ledger is untouched). **Realtime:** the `competition.{id}` and `competition.{id}.participant.{orgId}` channel auth; `live.updated` and `offer.accepted` sent to the §7.10 recipients; the lifecycle listeners bump `v` and broadcast. **Result PDF:** AR/EN, 9 sections, `PdfRenderer`, the `competition_report` file rule, regenerated at close and after award or revoke. `UiMoneyInput` ignored values set from code while focused (the composer's blur workaround is gone); kit inputs sent `class` to the inner `<input>` (new `useFieldAttrs()`: `class`/`style` on the field, the rest on the control); the public header's sign-in button ignored `hidden` and overlapped the logo below 400 px; the landing preview's amount and countdown collided at 360 px; the skip link could widen RTL pages (now fixed-position). **Layout:** `UiTable` gained `stackBelow` and per-column `hideBelow` plus denser cells, so W11, W17, W22 standings, W25 and W34 no longer scroll sideways inside their cards at 768–1280 px; stacked-card labels take at most half the row; `UiStepper` gained `collapseBelow` and a positioned root (the 8-step wizard shows "step n of 8" below `lg`); stat-tile labels wrap. **Consistency:** W23 status groups are tabs like W11; one coupon field (`BillingCouponField`, with `v-model:code` for the sponsorship quote) instead of two; `UiEmailChipsInput` in the kit; shared `formatMachineTime` (`utils/datetime.ts`, used by the offer log, feed, receipts and my offers, always with «(KSA)») and `formatBps` / `formatBpsPercent` (`utils/money.ts`) replace four store-level copies; the shared competition detail marks "Participating" as current in the side navigation for participants and invitees (`useNavHighlight()`); the invitee view no longer repeats the page header, and the participant header hides its countdown on the live tab (the room shows it); legal pages render one `<h1>` (body headings shifted, a repeated title dropped); the award detail's reserve label follows the direction. **A11y:** `useThrottledAnnouncer()` (10 s) for standing, the issuer console's leader and the participant's visible leading price (new polite region); the issuer console now announces opening, final window and BAFO politely and the close, award and cancellation assertively (S3, S9); send, reply, undo and sign-in/out icons mirror in RTL; registration has the unsaved-changes guard. **Copy:** «عرض» is no longer used for "view/show" anywhere (e.g. «استعراض الباقات», «تحميل المزيد», «التصفية»; the voice test now covers every namespace); dead keys removed. **Dead code:** `FEATURE_PAGES`, nav `available`, route-existence checks, the issuer coupon field and the duplicate helpers. Verification: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test` (52 files, 510 tests) and `pnpm build` pass. | Reverb is now exercised by the live Playwright specs (2026-09-30). Server-side findings for their owners (both fixed on 2026-09-30, handoff/mobile.md §9): the seeded legal documents start with an English placeholder line on the Arabic page (Platform), and the issuer rules summary calls a tender reserve «السعر التحفظي» where the glossary says «السعر المستهدف» (Competitions, `competitions.rules_summary.*`). Chrome logs the heartbeat's 204 as `net::ERR_ABORTED` after the response arrives (the empty body is never read); the server receives every heartbeat. |

"done" means the area's contract scope is implemented and covered by Vitest with mocked services. Every navigation entry is live; the review pass also ran the pages in the browser against the real API (see its row).

## 4. How to run

### Prerequisites

| Tool | Version / setting |
|---|---|
| PHP + Composer | PHP 8.5 locally (`pdo_pgsql`, `intl`, `pcntl`) |
| PostgreSQL | 17. Databases `bafo` (dev) and `bafo_test` (tests); unix socket in `/tmp`, user `hamzaalaydi`, no password |
| Redis | `127.0.0.1:6379` (queues, cache, sessions, rate limits) |
| Node + pnpm | Node ≥ 22.12, pnpm |
| Flutter | stable (Dart 3), with an Android emulator or iOS simulator |

### First-time setup

```sh
# API
cd apps/api
composer setup          # composer install, .env from .env.example, APP_KEY, Passport keys, migrate
# then set REVERB_APP_ID / REVERB_APP_KEY / REVERB_APP_SECRET in apps/api/.env to local random values

# Web
cd ../web
pnpm install
cp .env.example .env    # optional; realtime settings come from GET /app-config

# Mobile
cd ../mobile
flutter pub get         # also generates l10n
cp env/dev.example.json env/dev.json   # optional overrides; realtime settings come from GET /app-config
```

### Start everything

```sh
scripts/dev.sh
```

It starts, in one terminal (Ctrl+C stops everything):

- the API (`php artisan serve`);
- Reverb;
- a queue worker on `live,default,notifications,mail,billing,webhooks,pdf,imports`;
- the scheduler (`schedule:work`);
- the Nuxt dev server, if `apps/web/node_modules` exists.

Before it starts them, it clears the config and route caches and generates the Passport keys if they are missing.

Environment overrides:

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `API_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Use `0.0.0.0` for devices on the LAN |
| `API_PORT` | `8000` | API port |
| `REVERB_PORT` | `8085` | Reverb port |
| `WEB_PORT` | `3000` | Nuxt dev server port |
| `SKIP_WEB` | – | Set it to `1` to skip the web app |

Other commands:

```sh
scripts/reset-db.sh [--yes]      # migrate:fresh --seed on the dev database "bafo" (refuses production)
cd apps/mobile && flutter run --dart-define-from-file=env/dev.json
```

### URLs and ports

| What | URL | Port |
|---|---|---|
| Web (Nuxt) | http://localhost:3000 (redirects to `/ar`; `/en` for English) | 3000 |
| Web dashboard | http://localhost:3000/ar/dashboard | 3000 |
| App API v1 (web and mobile) | http://localhost:8000/api/app/v1 | 8000 |
| Health / app config / time | `/api/app/v1/health`, `/api/app/v1/app-config`, `/api/app/v1/time` | 8000 |
| Public API v1 (ERP) | http://localhost:8000/api/public/v1 | 8000 |
| Channel auth (Reverb) | `POST http://localhost:8000/broadcasting/auth` (Sanctum bearer) | 8000 |
| Reverb WebSocket | ws://localhost:8085 | 8085 |
| Admin panel (Filament) | http://localhost:8000/admin | 8000 |
| Android emulator → API | http://10.0.2.2:8000/api/app/v1, Reverb `10.0.2.2:8085` | 8000 / 8085 |
| PostgreSQL | socket `/tmp`, databases `bafo` and `bafo_test` | 5432 |
| Redis | 127.0.0.1 | 6379 |

### Verification commands (CONVENTIONS §10)

| Area | Commands |
|---|---|
| API | `scripts/test-api.sh <suffix>` (add `--parallel` for the parallel run), then `cd apps/api && vendor/bin/pint --test && vendor/bin/phpstan analyse --memory-limit=1G` |
| Web | `pnpm --dir apps/web lint && pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck && pnpm --dir apps/web test && pnpm --dir apps/web build` |
| Mobile | `cd apps/mobile && flutter analyze && flutter test && flutter build apk --debug` |

## 5. Alignment check log (2026-09-29)

These scaffold fixes were made so that the scaffold matches the contract. None of them adds a feature.

### API

- **`public_v1` middleware group.** It is now only `ForceJsonResponse` + `SetLocaleFromHeader` (ARCH §2.2 item 7). The deny-all `RequireApiClient` default alias and the Platform `public-api` limiter were removed: Integrations owns the client auth, `throttle:public-api` and bindings.
- **Rate limiters (§2.2 item 7).** `app` is now 300/min, up from 120. The `auth`, `guest-forms` and `guest-actions` limiters were added.
- **Public route files.** `routes/public_v1/{billing,notifications,platform}.php` were removed, because API.md §3.0 lists only integrations, identity, catalog, competitions and bidding.
- **Docblocks.** The module provider docblocks now follow the §3.2 boundaries. The `routes/channels.php` docblock now names the right auth path (`/broadcasting/auth`) and says channels are registered in the providers.
- **Platform config.** It now holds `web_url`, `pdf.driver`, `realtime` (from `REVERB_PUBLIC_HOST`, `REVERB_PORT` and `REVERB_SCHEME`) and the §15.3 setting defaults. The non-contract env keys `BAFO_MIN_APP_VERSION_*` and `BAFO_MAINTENANCE` were removed from the config, `.env.example` and `phpunit.xml`.
- **Endpoint shapes.** `GET /app-config` now returns the API.md §2.13 shape. `GET /health` now returns the API.md §1.1 shape (string checks, `queue` added).
- **`meta.server_time`.** App v1 success responses now always carry it (API.md §0.4).
- **`.env.example`.**
  - Added every §15.2 key, plus `ADMIN_SEED_EMAIL` and `ADMIN_SEED_PASSWORD` (§17).
  - `DB_HOST` is now `/tmp`, following BRIEF.
- **Ports and queues.**
  - The Reverb server port default is now 8085.
  - The Horizon supervisors are now `live`, `main` and `low`, per §12.
- **Storage and logs.** The `local` disk no longer serves signed URLs (D11: no presigned URLs; this removes the `storage/{path}` routes). A `private` disk and the `push` and `api_access` log channels were added.
- **Admin panel.** The primary colour is now `#0B7A55` (§16).
- **`scripts/dev.sh`.** It generates the Passport keys if they are missing (§14.2), and the Postgres probe follows `DB_HOST`.

### Web

- `useApi` now sends `X-Platform: web` and `X-Request-Id`. The request id is generated with `getRandomValues`, so it also works outside secure contexts.
- `ApiError` now carries `details`.
- The pagination meta types now match API.md §0.5 (`type`, `has_more`, and the cursor fields).
- A note in the Echo plugin gives the contract source of the realtime settings.

### Known gaps left to their owners

These gaps were not scaffold fixes. All of them were closed by their owners later on 2026-09-29 (see the rows of §1–§3):

- **Platform:** the kernel and middleware listed in §1.
- **Integrations:** `Passport::ignoreRoutes()` (the `/oauth/*` routes are live until then).
- **Identity:** the `User` model and the `users` table.
- **Web:** `useAppConfigStore` as the Echo source, and SCREENS R-W1 to R-W6.
- **Mobile:** SCREENS R-M1 to R-M3 (done in phase 1).
